[h4] ABOUT PGDM PROGRAMME
[p] PGDM programme is in its 26th glorious year. The first batch of the programme passed out in the year 1997. The programme has not only been benchmarked with the best in the country but with discipline at its core has helped students to rise to the top in their careers. The curriculum of the PGDM programme has the best and the latest topics like Robotics Process Automation and Liberal Arts.
[p] The programme further has been made vibrant by collaborating with IBM Skill build which provides the most latest topics in management like Machine Learning, Self Branding, Artificial Intelligence, and many other certifications which are part of the PGDM programme.
[p] The PGDM program is approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of HRD (Govt. of India).
[h4] PROGRAM DURATION
[p] The PGDM (Post Graduate Diploma in Management) in the past was called as PGDBM, where B meant Business. Seeing the wider spectrum in which the concepts of management can be applied, the regulating body AICTE on the country’s educators’ advice changed the programme name from PGDBM to PGDM. Now other than the application of Management concept in the business the programme trains students, its application in other areas as well.
[p] The PGDM programme of GHS-IMR follows the trimester system as followed by IIMs. In the trimester system, the examinations are held 3 times in a year. Thus a 2-Year PGDM Programme has 6 trimesters which are also called terms. Each term has 6-7 courses, with every course being 30 hrs duration. The term runs for 10-11 weeks and at the end of every term examinations are held. On the face, the system seems to be difficult but by being regular in class the students very easily sail through every trimester and finally completes the PGDM.
[p] At the end of the first three terms of the programme all students are required to undergo a compulsory summer internship for 6-8 weeks in any company.

198 [h2] PGDM Eligibility & Fee Details
199 [h2] PGDM ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
200 [p] Our PGDM programme is designed to provide students with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in their careers. We believe that quality education should be accessible to all deserving students, and we strive to keep our PGDM programme fees affordable.
201 [p] GHS-IMR follows AICTE specified eligibility norms while reviewing the student’s admission application. To be eligible for admission in our two year PGDM Programme, candidates are required to meet the following criteria:
202 [li] The candidate should be a graduate or appearing for the final year from any recognized university.
203 [li] The minimum percentage at graduation level for the open category should be 50 percent and for SC / ST / OBC / NT and others should be 45 percent or equivalent CGPA.
204 [li] Candidates appearing for the final year examination may also apply. However, admission will be subject to meeting the percentage criteria mentioned above.
205 [li] Applications accepted for PGDM on basis of CAT, MAT, CMAT, ATMA score. Once the applications have been received, candidates will be called for GD & PI Process.
206 [h4] PGDM Programme Offerings
207 [li] PGDM Programme with Dual Specializations.
210 [li] Training in Communication Skills & Personality Development
216 [p] At GHS-IMR, we believe that education should be accessible to all deserving students, regardless of their financial background. We understand that the cost of education can be a significant burden for many students, and we strive to keep our PGDM programme fees affordable. We offer a transparent and competitive fee structure for our PGDM programme, with no hidden charges.
268 [h4] EDUCATIONAL LOAN:-
269 [p] GHS-IMR provides assistance to students with renowned banks for providing an educational loan to our students on priority, subject to fulfillment of their terms and conditions.
270 [p] Our Education Loan Partners:
272 [li] However, the institute may not extend the time limit for deposition of fees at the time of admission or at any other time due to delay in availing of the educational loan by the students. The documentation support has to be honored by the candidates as required by the banks.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "sqlite3 -header -column assets/data/career_path.db \"WITH RECURSIVE tree(id,slug,name,parent_id,breadcrumb) AS (SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id,c.slug,c.name,c.parent_id,tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id=tree.id) SELECT id AS career_node_id, slug AS career_node_slug, breadcrumb FROM tree WHERE lower(name || ' ' || slug || ' ' || breadcrumb) REGEXP 'management|business|finance|financial|marketing|sales|human|resource|analytics|data|artificial|intelligence|machine|information|technology|cyber|crypto|logistics|supply|operations|project|six sigma|organiz|excel|design|english|startup|entrepreneur|commerce|accounting|audit|research|econom|commerce' ORDER BY breadcrumb;\""
